Accomplishment

Eight published books on Taiwanese history and culture; on and African American history and societal conditions; blog with 400+ articles; host of television show, The K-12 Revolution with Dr. Gary Marvin Davison (Minneapolis >>> MTV Channel 17, 6:00 PM, Wednesdays); multiple efforts to revolutionize K-12 education so as to bring knowledge-intensive education to young people of all demographic descriptors

Publication(Non-professional ones)

1. Culture and Customs of Taiwan (with coauthor [and wife] Barbara Reed, Greenwood Press, 1998)

2. A Short History of Taiwan: The Case for Independence (Praeger Press, 2003)

3. Tales from the Taiwanese (Libraries Unlimited Press, 2004).

Hobby

Reading a wide variety of genres, writing fiction and nonfiction, cooking in numerous styles

http://www.newsalemeducation.blogspot.com
